newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Elron 1996 estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Elron 1996 estimate cut.

text.p: Lehman Brothers has cut its 1996 earnings estimate for Israel's Elron Electronic Industries to $0.50 per share from $0.62 but is holding to its 1997 forecast of $0.72.

Analyst Theodor Kundtz said Elron was trading at a 13 percent premium to its estimated net asset value (NAV) of $9.73 a share, but said he expected the company to boost its NAV to $17 within one to two years. He maintained his 2-outperform rating for the high techology holding company.
Kundtz said his NAV forecast was dependent on a "significant earnings recovery" at Elron's main subsdiairy, Elbit Ltd .
"We will know more about Elbit's prospects once the detailed financials are released and the reorganisation of Elbit into three independent publicly traded companies is completed," he said.
He said Elron's private holdings, especially Chip Express, a semiconductor maker, would add considerable value to Elron in the next two years. Chip Express, he said, would probably go public in 1997.
Last week, Elron reported a third-quarter net profit of $0.12 a share, unchanged from a year earlier.
